title: Grilled Cordero Skewers with Smoky Aji Verde
description: A Peruvian-inspired dish featuring marinated lamb skewers grilled to perfection and served with a smoky aji verde sauce.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, blend soaked aji panca, garlic, smoked paprika, lime juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper until smooth.
Thread lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with the aji verde sauce and season with salt and black pepper.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until lamb reaches 145°F.
Serve skewers hot, garnished with chopped cilantro.
Serve with additional aji verde sauce on the side, if desired.
